name: IBY_PAYEE_
description: IBY_PAYEE_ is the audit table for IBY_PAYEE. Table IBY_PAYEE contains a row for each payee, such as a biller, merchant, or store at this site.

columns.name: PAYEEID
columns.description: Payee Identifier passed by electronic commerce application

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the internal payee for receiving funds.

columns.name: ECAPPID
columns.description: Electronic commerce application Identifier

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: User name to authenticate receipt of funds.

columns.name: PASSWORD
columns.description: Pass word to authenticate receipt of funds.

columns.name: ACTIVESTATUS
columns.description: Y or N flag to indicate whether the merchant is active

columns.name: SUPPORTEDOP
columns.description: Bit map to denote operations supported by the payee

columns.name: LOGO
columns.description: Logo for the internal payee for receiving funds.

columns.name: MPAYEEID
columns.description: System generated Payee Identifier

columns.name: THRESHOLD
columns.description: Threshold value to check against the overall risk score

columns.name: RISK_ENABLED
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether risk management feature is enabled

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Security group identifier used in hosted environments.

columns.name: MCC_CODE
columns.description: Merchant category code, or MCC, for this payee, if applicable

columns.name: MASTER_KEY
columns.description: Oracle internal use only, reserved for future use

columns.name: SECURITY_ENABLED
columns.description: Oracle internal use only, reserved for future use

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only, reserved for future use

columns.name: FINANCING_PAYEE_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only, reserved for future use

columns.name: DBA_NAME
columns.description: Payee doing business name of the payee for receiving funds.

columns.name: DBA_CITY
columns.description: Payee doing-business-as address city

columns.name: DBA_STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Payee doing-business-as address state or province

columns.name: DBA_COUNTRY
columns.description: Payee doing-business-as address country

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: User entered or system defaulted end date.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which payee is available for use

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which payee is available for use

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIF_SEND_FROM
columns.description: Send from email address for payer notifications

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIF_EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: Email subject line for payer notifications

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
